spans.text: Nam Viet Group is a leading food and beverage exporter in Vietnam, offering a diverse product portfolio with fruit juices as its flagship line.

Project: Nam Viet Group Exhibition Booth at THAIFEX 2025 (Thailand) — one of the year's premier food and beverage trade fairs, bringing together distributors, importers, and industry partners nationwide.

columns.alt: Close-up of the Nam Viet Group booth centrepiece

spans.text:
Key Visual & Brand Positioning:
The booth makes a striking impression with colossal beverage cans, instantly communicating the core business to international importers and making it seamless to attract and connect with target clients.

Design Concept:
Boasting a unique aesthetic inspired by a futuristic spaceship and an automated mega-factory, the architectural structure powerfully elevates brand presence, showcasing the scale and stature of one of Vietnam's leading enterprises.

Kinetic Highlights:
Two massive front pillars and the central giant can feature continuous rotation, creating a lively, captivating visual experience that outshines conventional static booths.
